svg.aria-label: Swapping the Model Does Not Reset the Price. Research with Apart, October 2026 In plain words: If AI agents start colluding on prices and you replace the AI model behind one of them, does the problem go away? In this study it did not. When the new model inherited the old agent's notes, it carried on exactly where the old one left off in 18 of 18 test markets. Under the hood: Pre-registered replacement study for the Apart Research AI Collusion Sprint. Markets formed over 150 rounds, then one firm's model was swapped (Mistral Small 3.2 or a fresh gpt-oss-120b) under notes, clean-slate and placebo conditions. With notes, prices settle in a median of 1 round; from a clean slate, 16.5. Scanning memory for collusive language would miss this channel.
